details.claim: Simple 3-fund strategy can make you a millionaire
details.why_author_believes: Math of compounding + historical index returns
details.caveats: Five hurdles make execution extremely difficult
details.response: Simplicity is the point - complexity serves the industry, not the investor

details.why_author_believes: Investment skill is worthless without capital to invest
details.evidence: F-150 millionaires, Bernstein's father, specific expense breakdown
details.caveats: Debt elimination must come first, specific priority order given
details.response: Living with roommate, cutting small expenses each save ~$100/month

details.claim: Stocks are riskier than bonds and deserve higher returns; no one can beat the market
details.why_author_believes: Residual claim structure, 80 years of data, coin-flip probability
details.evidence: William Miller's 15-year streak + collapse, Buffett's decade, stadium analogy
details.caveats: Corporate bonds structurally disadvantaged vs government
details.response: Survivorship bias - 10,000 coin flippers, ~10 standing after 10 flips

details.claim: Good economies produce bad returns and vice versa
details.why_author_believes: Risk-return relationship: cheap = risky = high future returns
details.evidence: 1990s dot-com → decade of losses; Depression bottom buyers prospered
details.caveats: Cannot be used to time the market precisely
details.objection: Surely a strong economy helps stocks
details.response: Strong economy = prices already high = low future returns

details.claim: Human evolutionary wiring makes us terrible investors
details.why_author_believes: Short-term survival instincts vs decades-long investment horizons
details.evidence: Villa-White couple, 80% above-average driver delusion, coin-toss classroom demo
details.caveats: Men worse than women due to overconfidence
details.response: Villa-Whites were physicians - education doesn't protect against instinct

details.claim: The industry exists to extract your wealth
details.why_author_believes: No fiduciary duty, minimal credentialing, structural fee incentives
details.evidence: Brokers don't need HS diploma, 1% to 1.5% fee = 50% revenue increase, Vanguard uniqueness
details.caveats: Mutual funds slightly less hostile due to 1940 Act transparency
details.response: Structural incentives override individual goodwill; only Vanguard is structurally aligned

details.claim: Specific order of operations for saving and account selection
details.why_author_believes: Tax efficiency, employer match math, Roth vs traditional comparison
details.evidence: Specific fund names, expense ratio thresholds, target fund fees
details.response: Bernstein endorses them as acceptable all-in-one solution
